products.name: Shubh Labh Toran | Resin Door Hanging | Pair
products.description: A pair of hand-poured resin door hangings for the festive season. Kalash, swastik, elephant and diya motifs are strung on beaded threads and finished with शुभ and लाभ lettering.
highlights: Pair of two hangings: one शुभ, one लाभ
Kalash, swastik, elephant and diya motifs in resin
Beaded strings with a loop for hanging
Handmade, so colours vary slightly from piece to piece
products.care: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. Keep away from direct sunlight and heat.

products.name: Blush Agate | Resin Serving Tray
products.description: An agate-edge serving tray poured in blush pink and sage green, finished with a gold-edged rim. Every pour settles into its own pattern, so no two trays match.
highlights: Blush pink, sage green and lilac layers
Wavy agate edge finished in gold
Glossy, wipe-clean surface
One of a kind: the pattern is never repeated
products.care: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Not for hot pans or the dishwasher. Keep away from direct sunlight.
products.notes: The brief called this a coaster; the photo shows a tray-sized piece. Confirm the product type.

products.description: A rectangular wavy-edge tray with a pink and mauve marble swirl and a gold ring accent.
highlights: Pink and mauve marble swirl
Wavy edge
Gold ring accent
products.care: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Not for hot pans or the dishwasher.
products.notes: Hidden until confirmed: this is a collab post on @sabbcreations65's profile. Confirm it is your piece and send a photo.

products.name: Newspaper Tribute | Framed Front Page
products.description: A front page designed around their career: a headline with their name and rank, their photographs and the story of their service, printed and framed.
highlights: A front page written around their service
Up to six of your photographs
Choose the layout and colours after you order
Optional warm LED lights
products.material: Printed front page, wooden frame, glass
products.care: Dust the glass and frame with a soft dry cloth. Keep out of direct sunlight.

Pearl-edged chalni with a shimmer centre
Gold leaf sprigs and bells on the thali
A keepsake for a first Karwa Chauth

Two gold katoris for roli and rice
Gold leaf sprigs and a small Ganesha motif
Made for Diwali, Raksha Bandhan and everyday pooja
